scope: Supplemental fixture and operator-policy changes only. Actual runtime images, authority, execution semantics and live configuration are unchanged. Domain fingerprints detect drift; this is not an exhaustive workspace audit.
reviewed_contracts: User amendment is authoritative: no physical reboot/power/sleep/logout or host-network/storage disruption, power-policy changes or unrelated shared-service restart. Normal-reboot startup assumption is explicitly not evidence.

New Nova fixture uses only label-owned disposable resources and synthetic authority/state; accepted archive/manifest/receipt checked and receipt unmodified. It cannot accept ambient database configuration.

Same immutable Next image is exercised through actual HTTP; interrupted duplicate does not dispatch, revoked token/refresh remain denied, completed state and exact persisted credit survive restart and new database/container reconstruction.

Supplemental fixture emits no credentials, removes private configuration and owned resources; internal-only application/provider/database and loopback-only fixed entrance. Memory pressure isolated to a separate 64 MiB no-swap cgroup; cache pressure limited to replica tmpfs.

Monitor test transfers only bounded synthetic code via stdin to tmpfs, replacing a workstation-bind assumption incompatible with the isolated daemon. Actual packaged entrypoint, ownership projection, sanitized status, control loss and restart/revocation checks pass. No live socket or credentials are mounted.

Current guide bodies and ACT-018 distinguish safe service evidence, historical acceptance, explicit operator deferrals and off-device gaps. Current-state entry supersedes prior actionable drill directions without rewriting historical records.
All ten live services retain IDs/images/start times/restart counts and Nova configuration hash. Shared ingress, actual grants, production databases and provider work were untouched.
verification: Nine isolated Nova check groups passed against the accepted image.
90 packaged monitor checks passed after harness correction; first two bind-rejection logs retained.
42 documentation guard tests passed; git diff --check passed.
limitations: No production build rerun or new artifact: test/documentation-only changes. Retained production build/whole-image acceptance still binds unchanged application bytes, and this supplemental test re-verifies the archive/package and public assets.
No physical-host, shared-daemon, live connector or off-device recovery test. No new real inference.
Separate OOM containment is not application OOM acceptance; container SIGKILL is independently evidenced.
ACT-018 remains open; existing public-release gates and due billing review are not repaired or reclassified.
